SELECT
    ContId,
    Continent,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CountryId) AS country_count
FROM
    continents
LEFT JOIN
    countries
    ON continents.ContId = countries.Continent
GROUP BY
    ContId,
    Continent;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT
    ContId,
    Continent,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CountryId) AS country_count
FROM
    continents
LEFT JOIN
    countries
    ON continents.ContId = countries.Continent
GROUP BY
    ContId,
    Continent;
